## Checklist

- [ ] Tested on a device (name the device and Android version below)

## Credit

- [ ] Code ported from someone else carries a `Co-authored-by:` trailer with their GitHub noreply address
- [ ] Every PR, issue or commit used is referenced as `owner/repo#N` or `owner/repo@sha` in a `Refs:` line
- [ ] New contributors, requesters or sources are added to `app/src/main/res/raw/credits.json` and `python scripts/render_credits.py --write` was run

See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full credit conventions.
